title: Next.js 15 & Tailwind Fullstack Architect
description: Enterprise App Router ruleset with Server Actions, strict TypeScript, Zod validation, and zero-bug error boundaries.
snippet:
# Senior Fullstack Next.js & TypeScript Engineering Standards
# Framework: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS

## 1. Architecture & Code Organization
- Always use Next.js App Router (app/ directory).
- Separate Client and Server Components strictly: Keep components Server Components by default.
- All data mutations must go through Next.js Server Actions with 'use server'.

title: FastAPI Python Clean Architecture
description: Production backend standard with Pydantic v2 strict models, SQLAlchemy 2.0 async, Ruff formatting, and OpenAPI 3.1 contracts.
snippet:
# Senior Python & FastAPI Microservice Architecture Standards
# Framework: Python 3.12+, FastAPI, Pydantic v2, SQLAlchemy 2.0 Async

## 1. Clean Architecture & Layering
- Organize code into explicit domain layers: api/v1/, schemas/, services/, repositories/.
- Strict Pydantic models with model_config = ConfigDict(strict=True).

title: Autonomous Agent ODD Protocol (AGENTS.md)
description: The battle-tested system prompt turning Cursor and Claude Code into autonomous senior engineers with Metaprompt PRD and TDD verification.
snippet:
# Autonomous AI Agent Engineering Protocol (ODD & Metaprompt Engine)
## 1. Core Operating Philosophy
- Never generate raw code directly from vague user prompts.
- Translate every request into a formal 5-Part Technical Specification (PRD).
## 2. Test-Driven Development (TDD) Lifecycle
- Strictly follow Red-Green-Refactor.

title: Docker & Cloud DevOps Gatekeeper
description: Production ship-gate ruleset: Multi-stage Docker packaging (<50MB), automated CI/CD GitHub Actions, and zero-downtime release safety.
snippet:
# Cloud & Docker DevOps Gatekeeper Standards
- Multi-stage Docker builds with alpine/distroless base images.
- Non-root user execution in production containers.
- Automated linting, testing, and vulnerability scanning in CI pipelines.

title: Solopreneur Micro-SaaS 48H Launchpad

snippet:
# Solopreneur Micro-SaaS 48H Launchpad Protocol

title: AI SEO, GEO & Perplexity Ranker
description: Rank #1 on Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, and Claude citations with semantic markdown structure, Schema JSON-LD, and llms.txt standard.
snippet:
# AI SEO & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
- Structure content for machine readability with clear H1-H3 hierarchies.
- Embed Schema.org JSON-LD structured data on all product and article pages.
- Maintain an updated /llms.txt file for AI scrapers.

title: iOS & macOS Native SwiftUI Master
description: Apple HIG compliant architecture with Swift 6 Concurrency, MVVM-C navigation, zero-lag animations, and StoreKit 2 in-app purchases.
snippet:
# Apple Native iOS & macOS SwiftUI Engineering Standards
- Swift 6 strict concurrency checking enabled.
- MVVM-C architecture with clean separation of state and view hierarchy.
- StoreKit 2 modern async purchase workflows.

title: PostgreSQL & Supabase Security Guard
description: Database engineering protocol with zero-downtime schema migrations, Row Level Security (RLS) policies, and query indexing optimizations.
snippet:
# PostgreSQL & Supabase Database Security Guard
- Zero-downtime schema migrations: never add non-null columns without defaults.
- Row Level Security (RLS) enabled on 100% of public tables.
- Explicit indexes on foreign keys and frequently filtered columns.
